findings.title: Gateway marked any non-'commit-unknown' receipt as accepted
findings.detail: core.ts dispatchOne checked receiptLevel === 'commit-unknown' else accepted. A structural adapter returning a Promise (natural for async HTTP) or a malformed receipt was recorded accepted before/without confirmation; undefined receipt threw and left the row 'dispatching'.
findings.fix: packages/gateway/src/core.ts: only receipt?.receiptLevel === 'accepted' is accepted; everything else is commit-unknown (fail-closed).
findings.test: packages/gateway/test/adapter-seam.test.ts 'unconfirmed adapter receipt (async/malformed) is commit-unknown, never accepted' (failed before fix: TypeError on undefined receipt after Promise/{} were accepted).

findings.title: Telegram adapter loaded via CLI config is inert
findings.detail: loadSendAdapter calls createAdapter(config) without deps.post, so every send is commit-unknown 'http-client-unconfigured'. Fail-safe and matches README ('no live network calls'), but no real HTTP path exists; sync send() seam cannot host async HTTP without a seam change. Future slice, not an S2/S3 AC.

findings.title: Companion reports ok:true for daemon-rejected requests
findings.detail: client.ts rpc wraps a daemon {ok:false,error} response as {ok:true,available:true,body:{ok:false,...}}. Error is visible in body; flag is misleading. Not in must-hold set.
